EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat All the Goblins!!
Thank you so much for helping me.\nI must thank the twelve gods for sending you...
I'm sorry for not introducing myself.\nMy name is Arone.\nI'm in charge of protecting the temple
She said thank you but she's still on guard.\nLet's ask her about the first magic stone.
You came here for the first magic stone?!\nSo you're just the same as the guys coming here\nto rip off the...
? A request from Pino?\nYou mean, the Goddess of Wisdom?\nOh! My apologies...
...I see. I'd really like to but...\nIt's more precious than you imagine, so...\nI can't show it to you easily.
Well, I'll show you if you [ffff64]get rid of\nthe monsters in the temple[ffffff]. How does it sound?
I appreciate it.\nThen, please defeat the monsters here on the list.
Thanks in advance.\nI'm praying for your safety.
Yes? You asking how long I've been here?\nWell... Four or five years I guess.\nI'm not really staying here for long.
When I came here, the temple was totally ruined,\nso I've been repairing the temple little by little\nin my spare time...
Yes, I heard something happened in the temple\nlong time ago and all the monks disappeared.\nThe temple was desolated since then...
What? Premiere Gem?\nYes, it was giving out the light on the statue's\nhand like that when I found it.
If the bandits had attacked the temple, it should\nhave been taken first.
All the monks disappeared...\nBut Premiere Gem was safe...\nIt's really a mysterious temple.
You're much stronger than I thought!
You must be the reincarnation of a famous warrior.\n...You're too modest.
Now I'll guide you to the room where the magic\nstone is. Come this way, please...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
